pip_requirements.description: Disabled: requirements.txt files are uv-compiled lockfiles owned by the pip-compile manager below.

pip-compile.description: Bump the human-edited requirements.in and regenerate the hashed requirements.txt with uv (command read from the file header). Replaces the old postUpgradeTasks, which the hosted Mend app does not run.

customManagers.description: Versions annotated with '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...' on the line above: shared Helm chart pins in helm-versions.auto.tfvars, AWS-specific pins in environments/aws/dev/variables.tf, and tool pins in workflows.
vLLM image in the LLM inference examples (not a Helm value, so no other manager sees it). Plain release tags only; -cuXXX variants stay manual.

packageRules.description: Group Terraform provider minor/patch updates; majors get their own PR (they usually change resource or block syntax)
Group Python linting tools (ruff + pre-commit hook)
Group GitHub Actions updates (digest pins)
Group Argo ecosystem Helm charts (argo-cd, argo-workflows, argo-events, argo-rollouts)
Group observability Helm charts (kube-prometheus-stack, loki, tempo, alloy, otel collector, dcgm-exporter)
Helm chart majors are breaking by convention: separate PR, never automerge
Auto-merge patch updates for all packages once CI is green
Pin Docker base-image digests for reproducibility
Group Python test dependencies

Image requirements: one grouped PR across the three images so pins shared between training and the transformer (joblib) move together. pandas, scikit-learn and cloudpickle are excluded below (serving-runtime contract).
Tool pins in workflows (terraform, kubeconform, kustomize, kind, kubectl)

Terraform registry modules (terraform-aws-modules/*): never automerge, review the changelog. Must stay after the catch-all patch rule (later rules win). A module bump that raises a provider floor goes red on its PR and needs `terraform providers lock` in that directory.

Kyverno 1.20 (chart 3.10) rejects create/update of ClusterPolicy/Policy (removed in 1.21), which every policy here uses. Hold the chart and the CI CLI on 1.19 until the CEL ValidatingPolicy migration lands (JDH-414).
Kyverno CLI in CI follows the cluster's Kyverno: hold below 1.20 and group with the chart (overrides ci-tooling).
loki 7.x in grafana/helm-charts is Enterprise-only; the OSS chart moved to grafana-community. Hold the grafana repo pin on 6.x until the repo move.
tempo chart 3.x ships Tempo 3, an architectural major with no rollback and a config rewrite. Hold on 2.x until that change is planned.
vLLM 0.x minors are breaking (v0.32 changed CORS, max_tokens and the transformers pin) and CI never runs vLLM. Never automerge; validate on a GPU session first.
kubectl in CI follows the EKS cluster_version (one minor of skew at most). Raise this cap together with cluster_version and the kubeconform -kubernetes-version.

pipelines/pretrained saves artifacts that KServe's huggingfaceserver loads; keep transformers on the minor that runtime ships (v0.21.0: 5.13, pipelines/serving-runtime-contract.yaml). Raise this cap together with helm_kserve_version and the contract.

pandas, scikit-learn and cloudpickle in the training and transformer images are the serving-runtime contract (pipelines/serving-runtime-contract.yaml): MLServer unpickles what the training image pickles, so they move only with mlserver_version, through the contract file and tests/unit/test_serving_runtime_contract.py. Renovate never proposes them (#143 bundled scikit-learn 1.9.1, which also needs Python >= 3.11).

Python interpreters follow the image lockfile headers (--python-version), not the latest python tag: 3.12 for pretrained, kserve-transformer, .python-version and the devcontainer (JDH-424). Raise this together with the lockfile headers, a recompile, and a live serve-smoke and model-save check (#142 proposed 3.15 for everything).

The training image's interpreter is MLServer's (serving-runtime-contract.yaml python_version: 3.10): the cloudpickled pyfunc must be unpickled by the same minor. Hold on 3.10 until the runtime changes (ADR-017). Must stay after the 3.12 rule (later rules win).

Manual merge only while the first Renovate batches are observed (JDH-406, decided 2026-11-01). Keyed on update type, not package name, so it also catches lockFileMaintenance PRs (no packageName) that :automergeMinor would otherwise merge. Must stay the LAST rule; delete it to re-enable the automerge rules above.
